title.narrative: EU partnerships position in the UNESCO Liaison Office in Brussels

description.narrative: The temporarily appointed Associate Partnerships Officer ensures the effective management and coordination of UNESCO’s EU-funded projects portfolio, in close cooperation with Field Offices and Sectors. The role covers end-to-end portfolio management (including cross-sectoral coordination on all EU related processes and workflows, such as new projects, quality reporting, validation, etc.), liaison and strategic engagement with EU institutions (and HQ/UN Brussels coordination), provision of foresight and donor intelligence to guide UNESCO’s EU positioning (including outreach to prospective partners such as the EIB), and focal-point support for UN Brussels Team processes linked to Global Gateway and the next EU Multiannual Financial Framework (2028–2034).
